Runs Apify Actors (ready-made scrapers and automations) and reads their datasets and stores.

## API key

- **Get your key here:** [console.apify.com](https://console.apify.com/settings/integrations)
- **Setting:** `APIFY_API_TOKEN`
- **API reference:** [docs.apify.com](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2)

### Get the key

1. Sign in to Apify and open [console.apify.com](https://console.apify.com/settings/integrations).
2. Create an API key (or token) with only the access your apps need.
3. Copy it. Many providers show a key only once.

**What to create:** The API token from Apify Console, Settings > API & Integrations; the Gateway sends it as a bearer token. Reading Actors, runs and datasets needs read; starting a run is a POST, so it needs write.

Steps for this provider are brief. [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20Apify) to request a full guide.

### Set it on your Gateway

From your EveryApp folder:

```bash
everyapp secret set APIFY_API_TOKEN
```

It asks for the value at a hidden prompt, and it's live at once, with no deploy. If an app you've installed needs it, `everyapp configure <app>` asks for it along with everything else the app needs.

### Use it in an app

List it in the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
capabilities: {
  apify: { access: "read", why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

`access` is `"read"` (or `"write"` where it changes things). The app calls the provider's own URLs with `integrationFetch()`, and the Gateway adds the key. More in [API providers](/docs/agent/providers).

### Check it worked

- `everyapp provider show apify` shows the key as set and which apps use it.
- `everyapp status` shows apps that were waiting for it as ready.
- To test the key itself, `GET https://api.apify.com/v2/users/me` with it should answer 200; the call is free.

### Cost and limits

- **Rate limits:** 60 calls a second. 60 requests per second per resource (one Actor, run, dataset or store); 250,000 requests per minute per user overall.
